_comment: Real reviews from Google Maps for Bakmi CC Jakarta - Kerobokan, used as a fallback while no live Google Places API key is configured.

reviews.author: Sheila Fernandez
reviews.text: If you're from Jakarta and missed Bakmi from Jakarta. You should try this place. You can order online or come to the store. The bakmi keriting is really good.

reviews.author: Mohamad Khair
reviews.text: I was warmly welcomed by the friendly owner and the staff and got myself Bakmie Ayam with Ice cappuccino. Bakmie ayam was good as usual. Good food and friendly people.

reviews.author: Maria Andreo Sisó
reviews.text: Coming from Spain trying to find local food and found the tastiest one. Both food and service were amazing. Definitely the place to eat local food!!

reviews.author: Josie Chapman
reviews.text: All the staff are amazing! Being from England I didn't expect to discover such a find!! The best food ever should definitely try if you come to Bali!
